description: This file defines the CashierData class, a serializable data transfer object for representing cashier information within the Apache Fineract project. It includes fields for IDs, names, dates, times, and related staff data, along with utility methods for instantiation.

classes.name: CashierData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a cashier, including fields for identification, work schedule, associated staff and teller info, with utility methods for creation.
